text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking and reminiscing
about the recent article in the school newspaper's special issue...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I wanna be interviewed toooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I heard Chrono-chan is writing
something for the school newspaper, you seeee... ♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
With me, nothing's off-limits! Photos, romance talk, all totally okay♪
Right~? Pleeaaase?

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
That is...! Being able to hear stories from someone
as accomplished as you, Pandora-san, is an absolute delight, but...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Riiight? And you know what? I got resort invitation tickets
from Papa, so I wanna take the photos there♡

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? A resort... you say?
Not... our training scenery...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
It'll be fine!
This is defiiinitely cuter, y'know♪
There's enough for three people, so someone could be like an assistant~...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, Trainer over there♪
Could you be our photo assistant? P-l-e-a-s-e♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: No way! The weather's super gorgeous!

Though I got dragged into this on a whim,
since I'm here, I want to help out properly.
May this turn into a meaningful interview...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Ice cream♡ They have limited-edition flavors!
Hey, I waaant some of that~~!

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes...
Shall I go buy some...?!
choice_data_list: I'll go get it, you carry on with the interview.
I'll go get it, you carry on with the interview.

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
Um...
Do you usually spend your rest days like this...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~~ Pretty much?
More importantly! There's a club over there♪
Today's DJ is super amazing, and~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
――~~♪
Hmm-hmm~~♪ Hmm~~♪

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... If you move around that much...
It ends up blurring no matter what, so...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhh? No good?
I mean, dance with me too, Chrono-chan!
Photos can wait for later~♪

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
...!
L-Like... this...?!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you got it, you got it!
Don'tcha have real talent?
You'll probably get as good as me in no time♡

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
Eh...?! I don't quite think... that's the case...
Still... Experiencing things is part of reporting too... right!

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
Phew~~~...
Pandora-san, you really spend your days off
quite actively, don't you.

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if spending time like this...
holds some kind of secret...?

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there's something about Pandora-san...
I've thought so for a while now.

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
I feel as though she...
is going to show us some incredible future...

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
When you untangle the long history of racing,
once in a while, a girl appears like a singularity.

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
It's not simply that she's clearly strong...
or that she set grand records...
She impacts history in a completely different way...

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
Looking back years later,
she's the kind of girl where one can only say,
"Her very existence changed the racing world."

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
I have a strange conviction...
that she might be one of those girls as well.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! Pandora-san,
you're finally back!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You forgot your turn to weed the fields, didn't you?
I took care of it in your place.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh nooo! Totally slipped my mind!
Sowwyyy! Thank youuu!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Man~ Eye-chan is seriously so reliable♡
You're the best! Just as expected!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like, whenever Eye-chan's around,
it feels super easy, or rather, feels like I'm the strongest☆♪

It might sound like an exaggeration,
but if Chronogenesis says so...
perhaps something like that really is true...?

text_block_list.name: Chronogenesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
Fascinating... isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Writer C
text_block_list.text:
"And so, this time we caught a glimpse of part
of her utterly lovable charm.
Going forward, we should keep a close eye on her on the turf."

text_block_list.name: Writer C
text_block_list.text:
"With this irregularly published special issue,
the 3-part serialized series, 'Extended Edition: Idle Historical Tales',
comes to its final chapter."

text_block_list.name: Writer C
text_block_list.text:
"Expectations are high for the future of the horse girls featured.
The next witness to history could very well be you.
　　　　　　　　　　　　(Writer C)"
